item.title: Mediaite Adds Cable News Veterans to YouTube Network
item.description: In an article posted to the site, Mediaite announced it will partner with major names from cable news as part of a slate of personality-led YouTube channels.

item.title: Dan Abrams Announces Opening of New Restaurant to Page Six
item.description: Page Six scooped the announcement that Dan Abrams is opening his latest restaurant in the Flatiron District this fall.

item.title: Best New York Wines
item.description: Nestled in the upper prong of Long Island’s two mystifying peninsulas, The North Fork is currently home to sprawling farmlands and over 40 beautiful vineyards.

item.title: 'On Patrol: Live' Hits its 300th Episode on Reelz
item.description: Variety Magazine reported that this past weekend “On Patrol: Live” hit an incredible milestone - its 300th episode on Reelz.

item.description: Danny’s is officially open for business, and the response has been phenomenal.

item.title: Mediaite Launches New Daily Subscription Newsletter
item.description: Mediaite is creating its own media newsletter that aggregates media news from other media newsletters. Yes - you read that correctly.

item.title: Reelz Renews 'On Patrol: Live' for Season 5
item.description: Deadline reported the news that the widely popular series “On Patrol: Live” has been renewed by Reelz for yet another 90 episodes.

item.title: Danny’s NYC Restaurant in Flatiron: The Reviews Are In
item.description: People have been talking a lot about Danny’s since its opening in October 2025. The restaurant isn't just getting buzz - it's been uniformly celebrated.

item.title: Dan Abrams' Law&Crime Network Acquires Court TV
item.description: E.W. Scripps announced on Monday that it is selling Court TV to the Law&Crime Network, which was founded by Dan Abrams.

item.title: Drinks with Benefits Wins Top 10 Best Specialty Food Festivals
item.description: USA Today just named Drinks with Benefits one of its Top Ten Best Specialty Food Festivals of 2026.
